text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Bahrain's electricity and water control centres are to be upgraded at a cost of around 600,000 dinars.
- Launch of commercial arbitration centre dalayed due to cash shortage.
- Bahrain's exports to Spain fell to $1.8 million in 1996 from $5.3 million in 1995.
- Bahrain to host Algerian industrial products exhibition on May 13.
- Bahrain Aluminium Extrusion Company to undertake a two million dinar expansion project.
